title: Annual Income
description: The total amount of money earned per year.

title: Credit Score
description: A numerical expression based on a level analysis of a person's credit files.

title: Postal Code
description: The geographic location of the applicant's residence.

title: Employment Duration
description: How long the applicant has been with their current employer.

title: Debt-to-Income
description: The percentage of gross monthly income that goes towards paying debts.

title: Marital Status
description: Whether the applicant is married, single, or divorced.
